messages:
maya-partnerships: Heads up — CS asked if we can lock marketplace SKU pricing for the upcoming SI joint launch this quarter. Need to align on private-offer discount floor + renewal cadence. Can folks chime in?

jonah-sales: Do we mean commit-based private offers or simple one-off coupon?

maya-partnerships: Commit-based preferred; partner asks for 12mo commitment with option to renew, wants 15% off list for initial 6mo then step down. Concern: we can't set arbitrary step-downs in marketplace UI.

liam-gtm: For joint announce, we need a consistent story. Recommend: 10% standard private-offer + 5% SI co-sell credit (booked separately). Keep renewal floor at 7%.

ana-legal: Need to confirm whether co-sell credit can be represented outside marketplace or must be on invoice. Also check entitlements for reserved capacity.

ops-bot: Deploy reminder: private-offer templates updated in marketplace-config repo at `git.redwood/marketplace/private-offers` (PR#412)

jonah-sales: If UI can't do step-down, we can put a manual renewal SLA: initial discount via private offer, renewal triggers a new PO with smaller discount. Ops OK with that?

maya-partnerships: Ops, can you support manual renewal flow for SI customers? We'll need a checklist: SKU mapping, invoice credits, entitlement tags.

liam-gtm: Also proposal to include a trial top-up (30 days) to accelerate adoption — might require marketplace coupon + backend entitlement.

ops-bot: @maya-partnerships @ana-legal I've opened an ops ticket #MP-881 to document manual renewal steps and tagging. ETA 3 business days.

ana-legal: I'll draft a renewal clause for the private-offer term sheet, adding language about co-sell credits and invoice treatment.

maya-partnerships: Great. Action items: jonah to confirm partner's desired exact discount numbers; ops to confirm manual renewal feasibility (MP-881); ana to draft clause. Return here with updates by EOD Thu. :calendar:
